title: Haunted Discoveries
description:
S03 E11 — Dead Lineage
Study the branches of a haunted family tree at Brennan House in Louisville, Kentucky. Learn why the successful, childless clan that grew up there always returned home to die, and watch as the team tries to find out if they've never really left.

title: Haunted Discoveries
description:
S03 E12 — Heart of the Haunting
New tools bridge a ghostly divide as the investigators reach out to old acquaintances at the Conrad-Caldwell House Museum; considering fresh data and insights into the Kentucky Anomaly that could help Brandon get to the heart of this haunting.

title: Haunted Discoveries
description:
S01 E01 — Gilded Age Ghosts

title: Haunted Discoveries
description:
